title: Morning rituals + errands + micro-tasks
content:
MORNING RITUALS (quick)
- 7:00 — cold water, 10-min stretch, brew tea
- 7:15 — inbox triage (archive / snooze quick)
- 7:30 — 25m focused block: unblock PR reviews

TODAY OBJECTIVE: land small diffs that clear infra blockers for embed cache experiment and get Dedicated quota request in for demo. Keep scope tiny.

TIME BLOCKS
- 08:00–09:00 — PRs + phone call with Morgan (quota details)
- 09:00–09:30 — sync with Kai: batching heuristic experiment plan (whiteboard)
- 10:00–11:00 — dev time: add opt-out flag for prefix cache 
- 11:30 — lunch out / post office drop-off (envelope for lease)
- 13:00–15:00 — focus: repro + perf runs on small model locally
- 15:00 — standup support + triage inbound customer mail
- 16:30 — follow-up emails, update Confluence notes

TOP-OF-MIND TASKS (one-liners / notes to self)
- Follow up with infra on Dedicated quota (Morgan): confirm GPU type and ETA for approval. If >48h, switch demo plan to hosted fallback.
- Add feature flag: EMBED_CACHE_OPT_OUT. Keep default true until we validate safety net. Small test coverage.
- PR review: runtime/#1837 — verify kernel fallback path when quantized model hits token length > 1024. Leave inline comments, request bench output.
- Draft short email to CS about potential regression window tomorrow (subject: brief heads-up: embed-cache experiment 3/22).
- Confirm meeting room for Friday demo (book amphitheater if >12 people).

ERRANDS / PERSONAL
- Post office: drop signed lease (11:15) — envelope + tracking receipt
- Quick grocery: oats, almond milk, bananas, spinach
- Pick up dry cleaning after 18:00 (belt + blazer)

MEETING PREP (Kai sync)
- Goal: land batching heuristic prototype and agree on metrics to record (p50 latency, 95th, tokens/sec, cost-per-1k-tokens).
- Bring quick experiment plan: small model (gpt-small-1) + synthetic skewed sequence length workload.
- Decide sample size: 2000 requests over 10 repeats.
- Risks: cache warm-up bias, measurement noise — plan: randomize start states, publish raw traces to S3.

QUICK NOTES FOR CODE CHANGES
- Implementation checklist for EMBED_CACHE_OPT_OUT:
  - env flag + config parsing (default true)
  - path gating in router (fast check, O(1))
  - unit test for gateway when cache misses due to opt-out
  - add e2e smoke to ci-fast (no heavy perf)
- Small performance test: script run_perf.py --model gpt-small-1 --batching heuristicA --duration 300s ; save results to /tmp/alexis/bench-03-21.json

THINGS TO DELEGATE
- Ask Kai to open JIRA ticket ENG-950 for long-term cache config UI (I will draft acceptance criteria).
- Morgan: please chase infra quota with cloud partner rep; cc me on the thread.
- Ops: set a 24h alert if error rate >1% after experiment rollout.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODOs
- Should fallback model for local demo be quantized variant or smaller fp16 model? Pros/cons quickly: quantized saves memory but may change output quality; smaller fp16 easier to reproduce. Decide by 11:00.
- Need clear rollback playbook for canary if latency regresses >20% — draft one-liner and attach to Confluence.

RANDOM IDEAS (brain dump)
- Cheap demo trick: show cost delta live with a fake meter in the console (UI) so product folks see dollars saved by cache/batching. Could be a toggle.
- Post-mortem template for experiments: hypothesis, set, runbook, metrics, customer impact, rollback steps. Keep one-liner at top.

END OF DAY 
- 17:45 — update Confluence experiment summary + link to S3 perf traces
- 18:00 — confirm dry cleaning picked up

---
Notes-to-self: be explicit in PR descriptions about safety nets. If I run into noisy perf, step back — don't ship partial instrumentation. Keep communication short and frequent with CS/ops.

Links I will paste quickly: Confluence experiment page (see linked artifacts), PR runtime/#1837, ENG-942 for related infra bug.
